_about: Hand-written HTML lessons for mathematics. Each is lessons/<file>.html (the header and article only; the site adds navigation, contents and the pager). Problem sets are lessons whose article has class "lesson problems"; the problem book gathers them. Links inside them are written from the site root, like /mathematics/P1-numbers-and-counting/.

lessons.title: Problem set: numbers and counting
lessons.blurb: Fourteen problems: √2 and non-constructive proofs, primes of the form 4k + 3, Fermat by necklaces, Wilson, the divergence of Σ1/p, Fibonacci gcds, every Pythagorean triple, Catalan numbers by reflection, Erdős–Szekeres, the party problem and the Platonic solids.

lessons.title: Problem set: analysis and the infinite
lessons.blurb: Thirteen problems: Euler's constant, e is irrational, Cantor's diagonal, the Basel problem by trigonometry, rearranging series, the Gaussian integral, Stirling's formula, fixed points, the universal chord theorem, AM–GM, the Gibbs overshoot, Cauchy's equation and Newton's method.

lessons.title: Problem set: geometry, symmetry and puzzles
lessons.blurb: Thirteen problems: Pythagoras by similarity, Heron and the best triangle, Buffon's needle, spherical triangles, polygon diagonals, the Koch snowflake, Lagrange's theorem, the cube's rotations, Burnside colourings, the fifteen puzzle, Fibonacci matrices, a hundred prisoners and Cayley–Hamilton.
